source_findings: Program uses WebApplicationBuilder.Build after its SDK registrations.

Default.NET10 sequential reverse stop means GenericWebHostService appended by Build can stop before SDK worker services; its StopAsync awaits Server.StopAsync. Actual effective options/order must be observed before making a runtime conclusion.

SDK activation StopAsync flips IsRunning then calls base.StopAsync; its ExecuteAsync finalizer awaits owned calls, retaining lease/slot semantics. Retry/poller/cleanup propagate stopping tokens and retain their existing scopes.

AdminOperationalIndexHostedService cancels its refresh token then waits with host token. Bootstrap worker completes activation once and has no custom StopAsync. Several validators/catalog registration hosted services have no-op stops.

BoundedTelemetryShutdownService is registered with OTLP exporter, has existing2second/provider budget and observes host cancellation; registered early, can be reached late in sequential reverse stop. No evidence establishes its execution or a telemetry hang in this run.
Fixture already sets OTLP exporter timeouts1000ms; no further timeout change is recommended.
